_doc: Minimap / map-state tuning (Update 04 section 2, DECISIONS T-065). discovery: a buyable's icon appears once the local player has seen it in person (within range_m, inside fov_deg of the view, nothing in the way; a ray hit within hit_slack_m of the POI counts, it is usually the machine itself); checks_per_frame POIs are tested per frame, round robin. discover_types: per game, the POI types that need that (the rest show when their area is revealed). fog: the map reveals in cell_m cells within reveal_radius_m of the local player on their floor. zombies: a shot that is not suppressed reveals zombies within reveal_radius_m of the shooter for reveal_seconds; 'Always' shows those within always_radius_m of the player; zombies more than floor_tolerance_m above/below the player's floor height are left out. view_radius_m: the three zoom levels (metres from the centre to the rim). size_px: the minimap's diameter at size 1.0 (1920x1080 canvas). icons: per style, the colours of the icon kinds.
